papers.title: U-TTT: Generalizable PET Image Denoising via Test-Time Training
papers.what: U-shaped denoiser with spatial and frequency test-time-training layers adapts per test instance; generalizes to unseen dose levels and scanners.

papers.title: Rethinking the Divergence Regularization in LLM RL (DRPO)
papers.what: Replaces DPPO's hard divergence mask with a smooth advantage-weighted regularizer; more stable off-policy LLM RL across scales.

papers.title: Attention Amnesia in Hybrid LLMs
papers.what: CoT fine-tuning collapses 256K recall in hybrid linear-attention models (67.2% to 9.4%); training-free QK-Restore reverts W_Q/W_K and recovers it.

papers.title: Infini Memory: Maintainable Topic Documents for Long-Term Agent Memory
papers.what: Agent memory as topic documents with revision semantics; targets contradiction, staleness, and unbounded growth in long-running agents.
